hints.title: Priority Rank Assignment
hints.text: Assign each element in the reference order an explicit priority rank equal to its position index.

hints.title: Counting Bucket Sort
hints.text: Since values are between 0 and 1000, frequency counts allow placing matching elements first and remaining elements in ascending order.

hints.title: Two Phase Population
hints.text: Iterate through arr2 and append each value according to its count in arr1. Then append any leftover positive counts in ascending index order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Custom comparator sorting takes O(N log N) time, whereas counting sort is purely linear.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed frequency array of size 1001 permits deterministic linear time reconstruction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that small value bounds make counting sort the optimal approach.
complexity.notes: Elements not appearing in arr2 must be sorted ascending at the end.
